items.summary: Replace the incorrect screenshot shown inside the landing-page hero phone mockup (currently showing the FunnAI Game Nest screen) with the user-selected image, and ensure it visually matches the other landing-page carousel screenshots (same crop/fit behavior and consistent phone-screen presentation).
